en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 1.03 percent lower at 23,508
en.dek: The benchmark fell 245 points on Tuesday as technology shares remained under pressure, with main-board turnover of about HK$198 billion.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed 245 points, or 1.03 percent, lower at 23,508.17 on Tuesday, according to market data.
Technology shares led the decline. Baidu fell nearly 6 percent after results, while Alibaba and Tencent also lost ground. The Hang Seng Tech Index dropped 1.14 percent to 3,758.

Chipmakers bucked the trend, with Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation and Hua Hong Semiconductor rising nearly 7 percent and 8 percent respectively. Turnover on the main board was about HK$198 billion.
The fall followed overnight weakness in US technology stocks and caution ahead of Nvidia’s earnings.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市跌1.03%報23508點
zh.dek: 大市周二收市跌245點，科技股持續受壓，主板成交額約1981億元。
body: 恒生指數周二收市報23508點，下跌245點，跌幅1.03%。
科技股領跌。百度績後跌近6%，阿里巴巴及騰訊亦向下。恒生科技指數跌1.14%，收報3758點。
晶片股逆市上升，中芯國際及華虹半導體分別升近7%及近8%。主板成交額約1981億元。
跌勢延續美股科技股隔夜弱勢，市場亦關注英偉達即將公布的業績。
